data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Thursday, September 10, 2026: Crypto prices slide back with inflation data on tap
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $78,291.64 on Thursday, September 10, 2026, down 0.2% compared to Wednesday's opening price. As of 7:19 a.m. ET this morning, the price of bitcoin slid back to $77,941.56. Ethereum opened at $2,467 today, down 0.7% from Wednesday's opening price. The price of ethereum slid this morning to $2,464.92.
